name: Centaur Bounty
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Now that you scared the centaur clans, it's time to bleed them.  When traveling Desolace, hunt centaur.  I don't care which clan you hunt.  Just gather ears.  A hoard of ears.

By weakening their numbers you will weaken their resolve, and stamp out any thoughts of expansion.

Good hunting, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Bring 15 Centaur Ears to Felgur Twocuts in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText:
By now, the centaur must know your name. I'm sure they know it, and respect it, and fear it. And just as they know you, they know the banner under which you ride.

The banner of the Horde.
narrative.requestItemsText: How is your collection of ears, adventurer? Large?
